scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,public,private -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w frontend-private"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w frontend-private
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w frontend-private
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && npx vercel@65.2.0 deploy dist --prod --yes --project lab-website
